customers_say: Customers find the door lock reliable and easy to use, with straightforward installation and comprehensive features. They appreciate its security capabilities, with one customer noting the anti-pry/tamper alarm, and find it convenient, with one mentioning the camera's usefulness. The appearance receives positive feedback for its stylish look, though battery life is criticized for being very short, lasting only 30-45 days.

reviews.author: Sai
reviews.title: Great lock and great support from Lavna team
reviews.body: Really good smart lock! It works well and has a lot of features that can keep your house safe. The customer support is really responsive and they helped me go inside my house when the battery died, All in a simple video call! Special thanks to Jatin who handles the LA44 model support, He instructed me every step of way to reset locks, use emergency power ports, etc.

reviews.author: srikanth allena
reviews.title: LA44 is very secure

The installation and setup were pretty straightforward. I really like the fingerprint feature — it works quickly and makes it so much more convenient than carrying a key around. The lock has been working smoothly, and I haven’t faced any issues so far. What I like most is the combination of security, convenience, and the overall look of the lock.
